Bug_Title: USELESS_STRING: Invocation of toString on an array (DMI_INVOKING_TOSTRING_ON_ARRAY)
Bug_Details:
The code invokes toString on an array, which will generate a fairly useless result
such as [C@16f0472. Consider using Arrays.toString to convert the array into a readable
String that gives the contents of the array. See Programming Puzzlers, chapter 3, puzzle 12.
Bug_Explanation: This code demonstrates the USELESS_STRING bug, where the toString method is invoked on an array. This will result in a string in the format of '[I@XXXX', where 'I' represents the type of the array (int), and 'XXXX' represents the hash code of the array. This is not very useful as it does not show the contents of the array. The Arrays.toString method should be used instead, which will return a string that represents the contents of the array.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case triggers the bug by asserting that the toString method of the array object will produce a string that represents the contents of the array, instead of the useless string [I@XXXX that the toString method of the array object currently produces.
